formats.title: 🎵 Edit formats to follow
formats.help: A specific visual idea and the audio or named format it belongs to. Check the examples, then find a way to make it yours.
formats.local: Following keeps a list on this device, included in your dashboard export. It does not send notifications or monitor your Instagram feed.
formats.evidence: {creators} identified accounts · {posts} indexed posts in the 7 days before the check. Search excerpts suggest this pairing. These are unverified leads: excerpts may include unrelated context, and the actual audio and edit are not confirmed.
formats.reviewedNote: Individually checked reference. Repeated appearance in your feed is a useful lead; wider popularity has not been measured.
formats.partialPlayback: Part of the video was visually checked.
formats.userDescription: Identified from your description; the full video has not been checked.
formats.captionOnly: Indexed search text suggests this pairing. It may include unrelated context; the actual caption, audio and video have not been verified.
formats.dateUnknown: No confirmed post date. Current momentum is unknown.
formats.stale: No fresh evidence for this format yet. Older examples can still be useful references.
formats.awaitingScan: The latest scan has no format-level results yet. Reviewed references and your followed formats remain available.
formats.emptyFollowing: Follow a format to keep its audio and examples together here.
formats.empty: No supported format found yet. A song alone or a generic effect name is not enough to identify one.
formats.scanFailed: The scan couldn't finish. Your followed formats and earlier references are still here.
formats.scanUnavailable: Format detection was unavailable in the latest scan. Earlier references keep their original check dates.
formats.noAutomatic: The latest scan found no supported audio-and-edit pairings. Reviewed references and followed formats are shown below.
formats.searchRules: Reviewed reference links are retained. Other results are unverified leads suggested by indexed search text. Excerpts may include unrelated context; the actual audio and edit are not confirmed.
formats.searchTutorialRules: Unverified tutorial leads: indexed search text suggests this audio and edit. Excerpts may include unrelated context; the actual post caption, audio and visual match are not confirmed.
formats.searchEmpty: No indexed search text clearly suggested both this audio and edit in this view. The reviewed example remains above. Search coverage is incomplete, so matching posts may still exist.
